mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and reduced corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for the HOUST-RSAFS interaction predicting 5-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals supply-side contraction that increases input costs and economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation that prompts central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for CPIAUCSL predicting 5-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 600 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity that signals economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through improved consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates recessionary pressures with accommodative policy, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for the UNRATE-FEDFUNDS interaction predicting 20-day SPX returns.
